normalized.result: Yes, editing right inside the card feels natural. I pressed **Edit title & description**, the title and description turned into fields in place, I changed both, and saving put the updated text right back into the same card — no jumping to a separate screen. Editing them together with one save is exactly how I'd expect it to work, and it's good to see I can fix up the auto-collected text after saving. This works well for me.
